1.explanation:
• button.config.js & button.js: Carbon core needs to know about a new size key (e.g. `expressive`) and to apply the 48 px height and 16 px font token when that modifier is set.  
• list.config.js & list.js: same for List—add an `expressive` variant that applies `$body-long-02` (16 px/24 px) instead of the default short token.  
• React Button.js & UnorderedList.js: expose a new prop (e.g. `size="expressive"` or `variant="expressive"`) and map it to the CSS modifier class.  
• styles/scss/components/_button.scss & _list.scss: define the actual CSS for the expressive modifier (height: 48 px; font-size: 1 rem; line-height: 1.5 rem on button, and font-size: 1 rem; line-height: 1.5 rem; reset paddings/margins on lists).  
• tokens.js (themes & type): introduce or alias the `$body-long-02` token for lists and a new button height token (48 px) so that both SCSS modules and JavaScript can consume the same design‐token values.
1.bug_scenario: IBM.com teams need “expressive” variants of the Button and List in Carbon 10 core (16 px font, 48 px button height, 24 px line height on lists using `$body-long-02`), instead of the current Carbon defaults (14 px/18 px line, 20 px–32 px button heights). The screenshots compare the IBM Digital spec (left) with Carbon’s default (right), illustrating the mismatch in font size, line-height, component height, and padding. We need to introduce a new “expressive” modifier on both Button and List, wire it through React props, the design tokens, and the SCSS modules.

2.explanation:
• button.config.js and list.config.js define the component‐level sizing and typography tokens for the core components; they must be updated to introduce the new expressive heights and font scales (48 px button height, 24 px line-height list with $body-long-02).  
• The React wrappers (Button.js, OrderedList.js, UnorderedList.js) map those configs into actual props, so they need to recognize and apply the expressive variants.  
• tokens.js in themes and tokens.js in type are where the design tokens live; you must add or expose $expressive-button-height, $expressive-button-font-size, and the $body-long-02 scale for lists.  
• The SCSS partials for button and list in styles/scss/components deliver the actual CSS rules; they must be adjusted to use the new token values for typography, line-height, and spacing to render the expressive variants correctly.
2.bug_scenario: The product team is proposing to add a new “expressive” flavor for Lists and Buttons in Carbon 10—specifically, a 16 px font size/24 px line-height list that uses the $body-long-02 token, and a 16 px label/48 px-high button variant—alongside the existing "compact" (14 px/40 px) defaults. The supplied images compare the current Carbon defaults (14 px/40 px, $body-short-01) to the desired Digital sizes (16 px/48 px, $body-long-02), making clear that new tokens and component configurations must be added or updated to support these expressive sizes.
